title: Ensure inactive branches are periodically reviewed and removed
description: Abandoned branches hold unreviewed code and stale dependencies while still being reachable and mergeable. They also hide genuinely active work in a long branch list.
remediation: Review the listed branches and delete the ones that are finished or abandoned: Repository -> Branches -> (branch) -> Delete, or push a deletion with `git push origin --delete <branch>`. To keep this from recurring, enable Repository settings -> Pull requests -> "Delete source branch after merging". Adjust the window with thresholds.staleBranchDays in scm-bench's config.
remediationZh: 检查列出的分支并删除已完成或废弃的：仓库 -> Branches -> 对应分支 -> Delete，或执行 `git push origin --delete <branch>`。为避免再次堆积，可在 仓库设置 -> Pull requests 启用「Delete source branch after merging」。判定窗口可通过 scm-bench 配置项 thresholds.staleBranchDays 调整。
